people usually say, "Go home quickly."

A good leader looks into the cause first, rather than just the outwardly visible symptoms.

id.description:
#PenulisNaMinAe #MasaRemaja #UntukSesamaIbu

Apakah anak-anak meminta Anda untuk menyelesaikan masalah mereka?

Atau mereka hanya meminta Anda untuk membela mereka?

atau menjembatani kesenjangan tersebut.

#AuthorNaMinAe #Adolescence #ToFellowMoms

As for being a mother…

They say watching over them is the hardest part.

When they fall, I want to pick them up,

And when they look like they're struggling, I want to hug them instead. But to think that holding back those feelings makes you a good mother.

Moments when you feel more anxious because you love them, and when you intervene more because you love them.

What do you think?

Kata orang, mengawasi anak adalah bagian tersulit.
